title: Retire completed proof-case job bundles and standardize intra-Lyra handoff protocol
summary: 4 proof-case job bundles (JOB-TM-001/002, JOB-DEL-001, JOB-GOV-001) are complete but not archived. Intra-Lyra handoff protocol not formalized as governance artifact.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16): JOB-TM-001, JOB-TM-002, JOB-DEL-001, JOB-GOV-001 are done proof-case bundles in jobs/ directory but not in canonical registry and not archived. Intra-Lyra handoff protocol not yet a governance artifact. Required: (1) archive done bundles (jobs/archive/ or archived status marker + index); (2) formalize handoff protocol as HANDOFF_PROTOCOL_V1.md in governance/; (3) add done-jobs index.
expected_closure_evidence: archival/index artifact proving the four completed proof-case bundles were retired or marked archived canonically
published governance artifact for the intra-Lyra handoff protocol
index or registry update showing where completed bundles are now tracked
requested_action: Archive 4 done proof-case job bundles; publish intra-Lyra handoff protocol as governance artifact; create done-jobs index.
proposed_action: Archive 4 done proof-case job bundles; publish intra-Lyra handoff protocol as governance artifact; create done-jobs index.
